note: Hand-checked by the F4 session on 2026-11-03: 8 of the 29 changes from live-run.json, each read against its saved page for the quote and the claim. The replay test submits these through the real pipeline and checks every quote against pages/.

changes.title: New Notion API version 2026-03-11 with breaking changes: after→position, archived→in_trash, transcription→meeting_notes

source.quote: We’ve released Notion API version 2026-03-11 with three breaking changes that simplify and modernize the API surface:

changes.title: archived replaced by in_trash in all requests and responses on Notion-Version 2026-03-11

source.quote: All endpoints now use in_trash instead of archived in both request parameters and response bodies.

changes.title: Data source/view queries capped at 10,000 results; check request_status.type incomplete

source.quote: now enforce a maximum pagination depth of 10,000 results per query.

changes.title: New public connections get a fresh access_token/refresh_token on each OAuth authorization; store every pair

source.quote: New public connections now mint a fresh access_token and refresh_token for each successful OAuth authorization instead of returning the existing active token.

changes.title: Notion API version 2025-09-03 separates databases from data sources; callers must upgrade to support multi-source databases; webhooks versioned too

source.quote: Our new API version 2025-09-03 separates “databases” (containers) from “data sources” (tables), unlocking powerful new organizational capabilities.

changes.title: npm @notionhq/client v5.0.0: targets Notion-Version 2025-09-03, adds dataSources.*, removes notion.databases.list; incompatible with older API versions

source.quote: The list databases method has been removed, since this endpoint has been deprecated & unsupported since `2022-02-22`, and v5 of the SDK is tailored toward `2025-09-03`

changes.title: npm @notionhq/client v3.0.0: minimum Node raised from 12 to 18, uses built-in fetch instead of node-fetch

source.quote: This update, v2.3.0 → v3.0.0, is marked as a major version upgrade due to the Node minimum version increase to 18

changes.title: PyPI notion-client 3.0.0: is_full_page_or_database removed (use is_full_page_or_data_source); is_api_error_code made private
